create_VizdoomEnv: create a VizdoomEnv instance with an action space and config file for Doom RL training
run_VizdoomEnv_step: run a step on the VizdoomEnv with actions and get observation reward done and info
run_VizdoomEnv_reset: reset the VizdoomEnv to start a new episode and get the initial observation
run_VizdoomEnv_play_human_mode: run the VizdoomEnv in human play mode using keyboard input for a set number of episodes
run_VizdoomEnv_replay: replay a recorded Doom episode from a .lmp file using the VizdoomEnv replay method
